title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: household add-on reduction of the reinstatement fee
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, where the enrolled employee also holds an active household add-on membership, the fee that remains after the membership-based goodwill check is further reduced by half, reflecting the household's broader relationship with the club. Where the employee holds no active household add-on membership, the fee after the membership-based goodwill check is not further reduced. The final fee amount is rounded to 2 decimal places.

Worked example (hypothetical): if the fee remaining after the membership-based goodwill check were $80.00 and the employee held an active household add-on membership, the reinstatement fee actually billed would be half of $80.00, which is $40.00. If that same employee held no active household add-on membership, the reinstatement fee actually billed would remain $80.00, unreduced by this check.
